passage:
Welcome to Sunny Zoo.
For the safety of our animals and visitors, please follow these rules. Do not feed the animals. Some human food can make them sick. Do not tap on glass windows, especially near snakes and small monkeys. Loud sounds may frighten them.
The bird house will be closed from 1:00 p.m. to 2:30 p.m. today for cleaning. Visitors who bought bird food tickets may use them after 2:30 p.m. or get their money back at the ticket office.
The zoo train runs every twenty minutes. Children under six must ride with an adult.
Please remember: a zoo is not only a place to see animals. It is also their home.
